title: Craft Plus +
description: mod that adds non-craft items to recipes
body:
Craft Plus+ - Unlock New Crafting Recipes!

Have you ever wanted to craft items that are normally uncraftable in Minecraft? Craft Plus+ makes that possible! This mod introduces new crafting recipes for items that were previously inaccessible, allowing players to create rare and valuable materials with ease.

!Warning mod requires JEI!
